turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I can't decide what to make for dinner on Saturday when my in-laws come over.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll tell you all the choices first. Wait until I'm finished before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first idea is a big roast chicken with potatoes and carrots, all in one tray in the oven.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's homemade lasagna, which I could make the night before and just bake when they arrive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is grilled salmon with a lemon sauce and a green salad, lighter but more last minute.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's it. Now you can comment.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Do your in-laws have any favorite foods, or anything they don't eat? If not, I'd go with the lasagna so you're not stuck in the kitchen. The roast chicken would be my second pick, it's simple and everyone likes it.
